text.p: These are the leading stories in Botswana's state-controlled Daily News newspaper on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Botswana Power Corporation (BPC) has electrified 76 villages since 1992 and another 20 are due for completion betefore mid 1997. "The corporation has by far exceeded its target of seven villages a year," said a BPC spokesman.

- Botswana has signed an agreement with Norway for the funding of a Pula 6.2 million air pollution and monitoring project. Under the agreement a national environmental laboratory will be constructed in Gaborone within the next three years.
